t: Leqaddesh hashshabbat beshulchan aruk ubiksut neqiyya
s: Leqaddesh hashshabbat beshulchan aruk ubiksut neqiyya ubo h' seipim: tzarik adam lesadder shulchano beereb shabbat lelele shabbat, veyatztzia hammittot sheyyoshebim alehem, vitaqqen kol inyene habbayit, sheyyimtzaennu aruk umesuddar beboo mibbet hakkeneset, shezehu kebod hashshabbat. Venohagin shehashshulchan hu aruk bemappa kol yom hashshabbat likbod hashshabbat. Veen leshannot. Veyesh nohagin lihyot b' mappot al hashshulchan millebad haelyona sheal hallechem, mishshum shekkeshemmenaarin happat — nimtza hashshulchan megulleh:

Tob lepannot qure akkabish mehabbayit mibbeod yom, lenaqqot et habbayit likbod shabbat. Vetob lizzaher bisuddat hallayla shello lizroq dabar babbayit chutz lashshulchan im en darko lekabbed habbayit bedabar hammuttar (ayyen simman shl"z) achar seudda zo, shelo yenavvel et habbayit, ella yizroq al hammappa sheal hashshulchan, veachar kak yenaarah chutz labbayit, veken bisuddat shacharit im eno mekabbedo achar kak:

Chayyab kol adam lehishtaddel sheyyihyu lo begadim naim leshabbat kepi yekolto, shetztzarik lekabbed hashabbat biksut neqiyya, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"b. Ubedibre qabbala neemar "vekibbadto measot derakeka", vedareshu chakamim "vekibbadto", shello yehe malbusheka shel shabbat kemalbusheka shel chol, sheyyachalipennu beacher (shehu naeh mimmennu), shehammalbush niqra kabod, shehu mekabbed et haadam, keshebba lemaqom sheen makkirim oto veroim oto labush bigde chamudot — azay hem mekabbedim oto. Veim i epshar lo lehachalip — lepachot yeshalshel begadayv kelappe matta, sheyyerau arukkim. Vehu middat ashirim hayyoshebim bebetam veenam tzerikim lesalleq bigdehem min haaretz bishbil melaka, ukebod shabbat hu. Umi sheepshar lo tob sheyyihyeh lo gam tallit acher. Veyesh anshe maaseh medaqdeqim shello lilbosh beshabbat mikkol mah shellabash bechol, apillu ezor umiknasayim vechaluq. Vetob lelek biqtzat bigde shabbat kol hayyom ad achar habdala bemotzae shabbat:

Yilbash begadim hannaim veyismach bebiat shabbat keyotze liqrat hammelek ukeyotze liqrat chatan vekalla, kemo shehayu osim gedole hachakamim, shehayu mitattepim bibgadim naim veomerim "bou venetze liqrat shabbat hammalka", vehayu omerim "boi kalla boi kalla". Ubiqtzat meqomot nohagim latzet mibbet hakkeneset lechatzer, velomar ken. Veyesh nohagin latzet hassadeh:

Vetob lilbosh bigde shabbat miyyad achar sherachatz atzmo, laken tob lirchotz samuk laereb velilbosh bigde shabbat miyyad, kede sheyyilbosh otam samuk liknisat hashshabbat, veyihyeh nikkar shebbishbil kebod hashshabbat hu lobesham:
